rules.name: xoga713-var-mult-view-vs-legacy
rules.sql: SELECT invenio_product_code, lot_mult, curr_mult, mult_factor FROM dbsystemuat.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE value_date = :cob
SELECT invenio_product_code, lot_mult, curr_mult, mult_factor FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = :cob

expect.reason: the new view must give the legacy multipliers (curr_mult = constant * fx), so the client statement fallback is not needed for these products
legacy has 124 rows per date; a product without an FX price that day may be missing in the new view
the new view must not invent products
